perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; directed reroute: Extend the fixed-stratum characterization to the published covariate-indexed model and establish joint cross-stratum realization and exactness for the propensity-adaptive hinge family. This would turn the current pointwise analogue into a correction of the published causal ambiguity class itself.

review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves a correct fixed-propensity convex-generator iff, stable binary counterexamples, and exact mixture/CDF formulas for a two-vertex bow model. It does not prove the corresponding equality on the published covariate-conditioned SCM class with one globally compatible structural model across all covariate values; the latent construction is performed separately for a fixed stratum and may vary arbitrarily with the target law. Consequently, the repeated description of the result as a “flagship” causal frontier overstates what is settled: the delivered contribution is a narrow pointwise probability-law characterization rather than a full correction of the published conditional framework. The simultaneous band is distribution-free only for the unconditional fixed-stratum arm CDF and does not close that scope gap.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Extend the fixed-stratum characterization to the published covariate-indexed model and establish joint cross-stratum realization and exactness for the propensity-adaptive hinge family. This would turn the current pointwise analogue into a correction of the published causal ambiguity class itself.

perItemFindings.label: ass:iid-sampling / S3
perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.Stat.IIDSample` is a data-carrying structure with the sampled sequence `Z`; wrapping it in `Nonempty` erases that sequence, so it cannot establish that the particular `S` used by `honestBand` is i.i.d.

perItemFindings.label: S2 / def:jk-ball
perItemFindings.one_line: `MeasureTheory.le_integral_rnDeriv_of_ac` requires an explicit `Integrable (fun x => f ((P.rnDeriv Q x).toReal)) Q` premise, which arbitrary finite continuous convex generators do not supply; the proposed real Bochner `fDiv` silently defaults on nonintegrable inputs.

review.verbatim_critique: Re-plan ass:iid-sampling so the actual sample witness is retained and threaded to the band/theorems (rather than merely asserting existence of some IIDSample). Re-plan the f-divergence layer with an extended-valued/integral-total encoding or explicit, reflected integrability treatment; do not claim the Jensen reuse is available from the current generator assumptions alone.

perItemFindings.label: S3 / ass:iid-sampling
perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.Stat.IIDSample` requires a Nat-indexed sequence with measurability, independence, and identical-distribution fields for every index, but the planned `IidObservationalSampling n Z mu nu` supplies them only for `Fin n`; the claimed `toIIDSample h` bridge with `.Z = Z` by rfl cannot exist.

review.verbatim_critique: Re-plan S3 and ass:iid-sampling: either use the full Nat-indexed field conjunction stated in F1-D10 so `IIDSample` is genuinely reusable for the same Z, or retain finite-sample assumptions and remove the nonexistent IIDSample bridge/reuse claim, deriving the needed finite facts locally or solely through the cited gates.
